experiment_contract.claim: Test the trusted selected_user_profile feature refinement on the current legal FM parent.
experiment_contract.expected_observable: Feature dimension increases and predictions differ from the parent due to added user-profile/item-context interactions.
experiment_contract.falsification_condition: Trusted validation shows no paired improvement or deterioration despite the feature-matrix change.
forbidden_shortcuts: manual custom rewrite of the catalogued operator
required_components: training and prediction both consume the enlarged feature matrix

fallback: If the incremental gain is absent, keep the legal minimal stack and seek more diverse mechanisms rather than further profile expansion.
hypothesis: Adding selected static user profile fields will improve personalization of item/context interactions and lift within-user ranking beyond the hour+user_gap feature set.
implementation_plan: Use the trusted operator selected_user_profile exactly, which appends the seven low-cardinality static pre-impression user profile fields through the features block on top of the current legal stack. No other blocks change.
justification: The task metric is within-user ranking, so per-user constants alone do not help, but FM crosses between user profile fields and candidate item/context fields can change item ordering within each user. This is a direct, applicable extension already supported by the trusted feature API as 'user_core', making it lower risk than bespoke feature engineering.
mechanism: add selected static user profile fields to FM crosses
observation: The current parent exact_parent_config features are only ['hour','user_gap']; the operator catalog exposes an applicable trusted refinement 'selected_user_profile'; and E002 reports that adding selected user profile domains on top of hour+gap+aux produced an incremental gain over the legal configuration family.

research_evidence.query: Which legal context and side-information fields complement the FM?
research_evidence.reason: Broad side-feature additions can add noise; legal temporal context needs an explicit availability rule.
research_evidence.summary: Prioritize low-cardinality hour and train-derived user exposure-gap buckets before broad profile expansion. Compute all quantile edges from train only. The hour+user_gap BPR configuration reached five-seed official-validation primary 0.604430330 ± 0.000459158; adding the censored watch-time auxiliary target reached 0.604607224 ± 0.000168363. Adding selected user profile domains on top reached 0.604821956 ± 0.000355822, a smaller incremental effect. The legal hour+gap+aux configuration also led the inspected random-exposure set at unbiased primary 0.378085981 ± 0.003012055. Any history feature must use train feedback or exposure-only information available at prediction time; evaluation-period long_view/play-time feedback is forbidden.

risk: Extra profile fields may add noise or overfit
Profile effects may be redundant with existing user_gap signal
